cues.sfx_prompt: Resonant brass financial exchange opening bell ringing crisply once over subtle precision mechanical stopwatch ticks and distant trading desk keyboard taps, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 纪实倒叙开场：金融钟声与精密秒表脉冲定调

cues.text: [measured] 十八个月后翻开公司法务归档库，那晚门洛帕克会议室的录音依然是最冷的一段。当时灵犀智造刚成立四年半，深圳一百八十名工程师正等着一亿五千万美元过桥款落地开模。
cues.director_note: 纪实画外回忆，贴麦温暖但克制冷峻

cues.text: [deadpan] 深圳这边已经是凌晨一点，我在南山无尘车间守着光学二供的最终排期。林沉发来一条短讯说领投方临时加会，我当时心里就咯噔一下——沙丘路半夜加会，从来不是来送温暖的。
cues.director_note: 周默纪录片访谈席穿插，构建双人纪实纵深

cues.sfx_prompt: Thick bound term-sheet dossier sliding briskly across a polished walnut conference table followed by a solid fountain pen cap snapping shut on heavyweight cardstock, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 切回沙丘路会议室归档原声现场

cues.text: [icy polite] Before we release a hundred and fifty million at one-point-two billion pre-money, Lin, explain the eighty-million-dollar loss in your audited filing—otherwise my partners require a thirty percent valuation haircut before dawn.
cues.subtitle_translation: 按十二亿投前估值打出一亿五千万美元之前，林，先解释审计底稿里的八千万美元亏损——否则天亮前合伙人要求砍掉三成估值。
cues.director_note: 纪实同传对 #1 原声轨：独奏 3.6s 后压混至 0.15

cues.text: [aside] 听她压住语速的停顿——沙丘路顶级合伙人从不喊价。她用审计底稿里那八千万美元账面巨亏做筹码，逼我们在天亮前自砍三成估值。
cues.director_note: 纪实同传对 #1 中文拆解轨：切入原声低轨之上

cues.text: [firmly] Do not frame an accounting mark as operating bleed, Victoria. [blunt] That eighty-million-dollar line is a phantom number, and your diligence partners read footnote nine yesterday.
cues.subtitle_translation: 别把会计重估包装成经营失血，维多利亚。那行八千万美元的数字只是个幽灵数字，你们尽调合伙人昨天就读过第九条附注。

cues.text: [interrupting] [coldly] Footnotes do not hide eighty million in red ink on a signed quarterly filing, Lin. Public investors punish paper losses just as ruthlessly.
cues.subtitle_translation: 附注盖不住签字季报上八千万美元的赤字，林。二级市场投资人对账面亏损照样毫不留情。

cues.text: [measured] Two years ago we issued convertible notes to our cloud partner. [firmly] When our equity value tripled, accounting rules recorded a liability adjustment on the balance sheet that flowed through into the income statement.
cues.subtitle_translation: 两年前我们向云端伙伴发了可转债。公司估值翻三倍后，会计准则在资产负债表计提负债调整，并流进了利润表。

cues.text: [blunt] It was not a cash loss—not a single dollar left our treasury. [confident] Your burn thesis just got completely refuted. Dollar for dollar, we are an extraordinarily capital-efficient hardware company.
cues.subtitle_translation: 这不是现金亏损——我们资金池一分钱都没流出。你们那套烧钱论断被彻底推翻了。按每一美元产出算，我们是一家资本效率极高的硬件公司。

cues.text: [measured] Our external auditor attached a two-page clearance letter confirming zero operating cash outflow, Victoria. [blunt] The bridge valuation math holds.
cues.subtitle_translation: 我们的外部审计师附上了两页澄清函，确认零经营现金流出，维多利亚。这轮过桥估值账本完全成立。

cues.text: [measured] 事后克莱尔跟我复盘说，八千万亏损只是维多利亚的试探拳。她真正的杀招根本不在硅谷，而是门外那位从伦敦飞来、掌管牛津街旗舰百货数码采购的英国绅士。

cues.sfx_prompt: Heavy frameless tempered glass boardroom door swinging shut with a muted brushed-steel hydraulic latch click inside a quiet Sand Hill Road office suite, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 会议室玻璃门推开，伦敦买手 Alistair 入场

cues.text: [aside] 阿利斯泰尔一坐下，整个玻璃会议室的温度瞬间掉了五度。他手握伦敦牛津街和跨大西洋消费电子旗舰联盟的首发货架权，也是欧美高端渠道真正的守门人。

[understated] [clears throat] Good evening, Mr. Chen. [icy polite] Your thirty-eight-gram titanium glasses look splendid under Oxford Street spotlights—which makes the unit economics all the more painful.
cues.subtitle_translation: 晚上好，陈先生。你这副三十八克钛合金眼镜在牛津街射灯下确实优雅——正因如此，单台经济账才显得格外刺眼。

cues.text: [measured] Three hundred ninety-nine dollars retail—three twenty-nine pounds in London. [deadpan] Subtract our forty percent retail margin and you collect two hundred thirty-nine point four wholesale, before eight percent co-op marketing.
cues.subtitle_translation: 零售三百九十九美元、伦敦三百二十九英镑。扣完我们四成零售毛利，你批发净收两百三十九点四美元，这还没算百分之八联合营销费。

cues.text: [pushback] Alistair, co-op fees and slotting terms remain unexecuted in schedule two. [blunt] Our wholesale baseline is two thirty-nine point four net, period.
cues.subtitle_translation: 阿利斯泰尔，联合营销费和进场费在附表二尚未生效。我们的批发底线就是净收两百三十九点四美元，没有商量。

cues.text: [coldly] Very well, Ms. Sterling. Keep your wholesale net—then deduct one hundred forty-two dollars of Shenzhen assembly and eighteen cents per day of public cloud vision calls. [sarcastic] That is one hundred ninety-seven dollars over three years.
cues.subtitle_translation: 好吧，斯特林女士。按你的净批发价算——再扣掉一百四十二美元深圳制造成本，加上每天十八美分的公有云视觉调用费。三年就是一百九十七美元。

cues.text: [dismissive] And if your factory return rate climbs past two-point-five percent, Oxford Street will pull your display before autumn. [icy polite] Now listen carefully to my board's objection.
cues.subtitle_translation: 而且只要你们出厂退货率超过百分之二点五，牛津街秋天前就会撤掉你的展台。现在仔细听我董事会的反对理由。

cues.text: [icy polite] Expensive cloud AI is already eating into budgets across every luxury floor I manage, Mr. Chen—and that is a really hard trade-off for Oxford Street to ignore when shoppers expect zero subscription friction.
cues.subtitle_translation: 高昂的云端算力已经在啃噬我管辖的每一层精品卖场预算，陈先生——当顾客拒绝额外订阅摩擦时，这是牛津街极难忽略的残酷权衡。
cues.director_note: Viral Clip D 0-3s 钩子 + 纪实同传对 #2 原声轨（独奏 3.8s -> 压混 0.15）

cues.text: [aside] 注意这句极度优雅的伦敦英语：他不说你成本失控，只说云端算力正在啃噬预算、是个残酷权衡。翻译过来就是：云费压不下去，牛津街货架免谈。
cues.director_note: 纪实同传对 #2 中文同传拆解轨

cues.text: [blunt] Forget frontier model leaderboards, Lin. [coldly] Buyers only ask two questions: What is good enough, and what does it cost to run this thing a million times?
cues.subtitle_translation: 忘掉前沿模型跑分榜吧，林。买家只问两个问题：做到什么程度算够用，把这东西跑一百万次要多少钱？

cues.text: [understated] You pitched huge three-year subscription upside. [coldly] Fine—when are you going to get it?
cues.subtitle_translation: 你路演时吹嘘三年订阅有巨大上行空间。好——你到底什么时候能拿到这笔钱？

cues.text: [interrupting] [firmly] On invoice day one, Victoria—not year three. [measured] Because ten minutes ago, my Shenzhen cleanroom just eliminated seventy-eight percent of that cloud bill.
cues.subtitle_translation: 开票第一天就落袋，维多利亚——不用等第三年。因为十分钟前，我的深圳无尘车间刚刚砍掉了百分之七十八的云端账单。
cues.director_note: Viral Clip D 反转收尾（区间 vd_020 .. vd_024）

cues.sfx_prompt: Crisp minimalist titanium smart-glasses temple haptic tap followed by a subtle ultra-clean low-latency micro-chime and soft optical shutter pulse in close stereo proximity, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 镜腿提示音切入深圳产线纪实回忆

cues.sfx_prompt: Precision high-speed surface-mount pick-and-place robotics humming rhythmically beside soft pneumatic air valves and optical inspection conveyor clicks inside a Shenzhen electronics cleanroom, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 深圳南山无尘车间环境底噪垫入纪实访谈

cues.text: [wryly] 后来外头总问，那晚我们到底拿什么翻的盘？其实根本没什么硅谷魔法，就是南山产线熬了三周通宵，把光学微显示二供切出来，整机 BOM cost 从一百四十二美金硬压到一百二十四美金，省出十八块真金白银。
cues.director_note: 周默纪录片访谈席视角，平实硬核

cues.text: [blunt] 同时我们把日常语音和字幕蒸馏进本地 NPU，把每天十八美分的公有云调用砸到四美分，降幅百分之七十八。而且五千副老化全检跑完，不良率压死在百分之一点八，离伦敦百分之二点五的红线还富余一大截。
[measured] 当老周把百万次压测日志直接同步到门洛帕克会议桌平板上时，我看到阿利斯泰尔第一次停下了手里的钢笔。

cues.sfx_prompt: Crisp executive smartphone conference bridge dial chime clicking cleanly into a quiet transpacific encrypted telecom line hum across an empty midnight desk, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 切回当晚跨太平洋实时日志传入会议室瞬间

cues.text: [measured] Live cleanroom logs are on your tablets. [confident] Optical re-sourcing cut eighteen dollars off our bill of materials to one twenty-four, and local inference drops daily cloud spend to four cents.
cues.subtitle_translation: 实时产线日志已经发到你们平板上了。光学重新寻源砍掉十八美元物料成本至一百二十四美元，端侧推理把单日云端成本降到四美分。

cues.text: [skeptical] Four cents sounds miraculous, Mr. Chen. [icy polite] Yet bargain processors typically choke on real-time translation inside a noisy department store.
cues.subtitle_translation: 四美分听着像奇迹，陈先生。但廉价处理器在嘈杂百货商场里做实时翻译通常都会卡死。

cues.text: [interrupting] [blunt] Stop pricing bare silicon—optics and backend land power and shell are fixed anyway. Pick your favorite number on chip cost; our quantized stack delivers 10 times the throughput per watt and the lowest cost tokens on the glass.
cues.subtitle_translation: 别再按裸芯片算钱——光学和后端机房土建电力本来是刚性固定项。芯片单价随便你挑；我们的量化架构每瓦跑出十倍吞吐量，并在镜片端产出最低成本词元。
cues.director_note: 纪实同传对 #3 原声轨：独奏 4.0s 后压混至 0.15

cues.text: [deadpan] 这一句在录音里我回听了五遍。按单颗芯片算钱全是外行，把固定机房和光学成本放进总账，每瓦跑出十倍吞吐量才是降维打击。
cues.director_note: 纪实同传对 #3 周默画外访谈拆解轨

cues.text: [firmly] In other words, run this thing a million times and our three-year compute bill is forty-four dollars, not one ninety-seven. [confident] Even after your forty percent shelf margin, we clear seventy-one dollars net hardware profit on day one.
cues.subtitle_translation: 换句话说，把这东西跑一百万次，我们的三年算力账单是四十四美元，不是一百九十七美元。即便扣完你们四成货架毛利，出货首日我们也净赚七十一美元。

cues.text: [understated] [short pause] Seventy-one dollars of net hardware headroom and one-point-eight percent factory defects. [measured] Remarkable, Mr. Chen. Oxford Street will endorse your flagship launch order Monday morning.
cues.subtitle_translation: 七十一美元硬件净盈余，加上百分之一点八出厂不良率。了不起，陈先生。牛津街周一早上就会批复你的旗舰首发订单。

cues.text: [firmly] And to lock the commercial record, Alistair, our federal wireless certification cleared testing this morning—so North American retail shipments face zero regulatory delay.
cues.subtitle_translation: 顺便锁死商业纪要，阿利斯泰尔，我们的联邦无线认证今天上午刚通过检测——北美零售出货零合规延误。

cues.text: [icy polite] Even better, Ms. Sterling. [measured] Clear ten thousand units cleanly across London and Manchester in month one, and my European luxury syndicate opens thirty additional flagship counters.
cues.subtitle_translation: 那就更理想了，斯特林女士。首月在伦敦和曼彻斯特干净出货一万台，我的欧洲精品百货联盟立刻给你加开三十个旗舰专柜。

cues.text: [measured] 伦敦大买手点头的那一刻，维多利亚立刻撤回了三成估值砍价。会议室气氛松了足足三秒——直到法务克莱尔把合同翻到了第十四页。

cues.sfx_prompt: Thick bound term-sheet dossier sliding briskly across a polished walnut conference table followed by a solid fountain pen cap snapping shut on heavyweight cardstock, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 合同第 14 页重拍胡桃木长桌

cues.text: [blunt] Stop right there, Lin—do not initial page one. Victoria restored your one-point-two-billion pre-money because Schedule C on page fourteen hides a sixty-day hard milestone: fifty thousand confirmed Western units, or Apex Horizon takes automatic board veto power.
cues.subtitle_translation: 停笔，林——别在首页落款。维多利亚恢复你的十二亿投前估值，是因为第十四页附录三藏着六十天硬对赌：拿不下五万台欧美确认订单，Apex Horizon 自动接管董事会否决权。
cues.director_note: 纪实同传对 #4 原声轨：法务警报独奏 3.8s 后压混至 0.15

cues.text: [tense] 后来我才明白，八千万账面巨亏只是烟雾弹。第十四页这条六十天五万台硬对赌，才是维多利亚准备夺走董事会控制权的真正锁链。
cues.director_note: 纪实同传对 #4 林沉纪实揭底轨

cues.text: [icy polite] A fair test of conviction, Claire. [coldly] One hundred fifty million wires at sunrise; deliver fifty thousand retail units inside sixty days, and my veto evaporates.
cues.subtitle_translation: 很公平的信念测试，克莱尔。日出时打出一亿五千万美元；六十天交付五万台欧美零售订单，我的否决权烟消云散。

cues.text: [interrupting] [guarded] London covers ten thousand units, Lin. [tense] Finding forty thousand more across North America before a potential twenty-five percent tariff hits is a razor-thin sixty-day wire.
cues.subtitle_translation: 伦敦只包一万台，林。在潜在百分之二十五关税冲击落地前从北美再抢下四万台，这六十天就像走钢丝。

cues.text: [blunt] At minimum, Victoria, strip the super-voting trigger and insert a fifteen-day cure period for customs or port disruption. [firmly] No founder signs an uncapped governance trap.
cues.subtitle_translation: 维多利亚，最起码撤掉超级投票权触发条款，为海关或港口延误加上十五天补救宽限期。没有创始人会签无上限的控制权陷阱。

cues.text: [interrupting] [coldly] Ten-day customs cure—not fifteen, and the board veto stays intact if retail demand misses fifty thousand. [icy polite] You have sixty seconds to decide, Lin.
cues.subtitle_translation: 海关补救期给十天——不给十五天，而且只要零售需求达不到五万台，董事会否决权纹丝不动。给你六十秒做决定，林。

cues.text: [firmly] Ten-day customs cure goes on page fourteen, Victoria. [understated] Sixty days. Fifty thousand units. Wire the capital before sunrise.
cues.subtitle_translation: 十天海关补救期写进第十四页，维多利亚。六十天，五万台。日出前把钱打到账。

cues.text: [understated] [clears throat] Quiet nerve, Mr. Chen. [measured] Deliver the first ten thousand to Heathrow on schedule, and London will keep its word while Sand Hill Road watches the clock.
cues.subtitle_translation: 够沉得住气，陈先生。按期把首批一万台送到希思罗机场，当沙丘路盯着倒计时的时候，伦敦绝不食言。

cues.text: [firmly] 后来林沉跟我说，那晚签完字出门，门洛帕克的夜风冷得像刀子。可只要深圳五万台起订产能不断链，我们就不可能输在牌桌上。
[coldly] 十二亿估值守住了，但六十天跨境生死局才刚刚按下秒表。

cues.sfx_prompt: Crisp minimalist titanium smart-glasses temple haptic tap followed by a subtle ultra-clean low-latency micro-chime and soft optical shutter pulse in close stereo proximity, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 切入 Act 5 极速高管闪卡与第二集先导预告

cues.text: [coach] 档案合上，进入两分钟极速高管闪卡。下面四组今晚最致命的真实交锋句，零点八倍慢速拆清连读，紧跟原速复述一遍。
[coach] 闪卡一：击穿账面巨亏。别说没亏真钱，用幽灵数字加账面流进利润表定调。
[coach] That loss is a phantom number—it flowed through into the income statement, not a cash loss.
cues.subtitle_translation: 那笔亏损只是幽灵数字——仅仅账面流进了利润表，不是现金亏损。
cues.director_note: Act 5 0.80x 慢拆（复用 1.0x 干声经 FFmpeg atempo 保音高拉慢）

cues.text: [coach] That loss is a phantom number—it flowed through into the income statement, not a cash loss.
cues.subtitle_translation: 那笔亏损只是幽灵数字——仅仅账面流进了利润表，不是现金亏损。
cues.director_note: Act 5 1.0x 原速跟读（留白 2.3s 供开口复述）

cues.text: [coach] 闪卡二：拆解大渠道优雅砍价。啃噬预算配残酷权衡，感受英音清脆爆破。
[coach] Expensive AI is eating into budgets, and that is a really hard trade-off to ignore.
cues.subtitle_translation: 高昂算力正在啃噬预算，这是极难忽略的残酷权衡。
cues.director_note: Act 5 0.80x 慢拆（复用 1.0x 干声经 FFmpeg atempo 保音高拉慢）

cues.text: [coach] Expensive AI is eating into budgets, and that is a really hard trade-off to ignore.
cues.subtitle_translation: 高昂算力正在啃噬预算，这是极难忽略的残酷权衡。
cues.director_note: Act 5 1.0x 原速跟读（留白 2.3s 供开口复述）

cues.text: [coach] 闪卡三：击碎跑分虚荣。买家只问够用底线和跑一百万次的真实成本。
[coach] What is good enough, and what does it cost to run this thing a million times?
cues.subtitle_translation: 做到什么程度才算够用，跑一百万次又要花多少钱？
